## What's Changed
### New Features 🎉
* Add stack trace info to missing label warning by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11187
* added server.FolderWatchList to cli + LocalSourcesWatcher by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9656
* [AdvancedLayouts] Adds a width parameter to st.code by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11176
* [AdvancedLayouts] Adds a width parameter to st.json by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11177
* [AdvancedLayouts] Adds a width parameter to st.help by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11181
* [AdvancedLayouts] Adds a width parameter to st.progress by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11182
* [AdvancedLayouts] Adds a width parameter to st.audio_input by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11243
* [AdvancedLayouts] Adds a width parameter to st.slider, st.select_slider by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11233
* [AdvancedLayouts] Adds a width parameter to st.camera_input and st.file_uploader by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11246
* [AdvancedLayouts] Adds a width parameter to st.text_input and st.text_area by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11255
* [AdvancedLayouts] Adds a width parameter to st.number_input and st.selectbox by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11257
* [AdvancedLayouts] Adds a width parameter to st.date_input and st.time_input by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11260
* Allow nesting expander, columns, popover and chat_message by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11272
* Fix #10475: Warn when modifying elements inside fragment callback by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10942
* Make Carto the default map provider (like in PyDeck) by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11231
* Remove `set_page_config` restrictions by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11286
* [AdvancedLayouts] Adds a width parameter to st.chat_input and st.chat_message by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11298
* [AdvancedLayouts] Adds st.column(gap="none") by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11321
* [AdvancedLayouts] Adds a width parameter to st.video and st.audio by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11263
* Add a new config option to configure a CORS allowlist by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11377
* [AdvancedLayouts] Extend height param on code to support new options.  by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11355
* Fix: StreamlitDuplicateElementId when same widget is both in the main and sidebar area by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10881
* [AdvancedLayouts] Adds a width parameter to st.latex and st.divider by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11320
* Serve manifest.json from static asset handler by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11462
* Always show dataframe row selection checkboxes by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11411
* [AdvancedLayouts] Adds a width parameter to st.tabs and st.expander by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11445
* [AdvancedLayouts] Adds a width parameter to st.status by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11466
* [AdvancedLayouts] Adds a width and height parameters to st.form by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11447
* Add `buttonRadius` theming config option by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11464
* Rename backend base url window variables to use __streamlit object by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11481
* Small improvements to Streamlit Hello by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11442
* [AdvancedLayouts] Change to use None instead of "none" for column gap size. by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11482
* Add `dataframeBorderColor` theming config option by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11475
* Add support for config & secret files on main-script level by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10173
* [AdvancedLayouts] Adds a width parameter to st.text by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11167
* [AdvancedLayouts] Adds a width parameter to st.metric by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11159
* [AdvancedLayouts] Adds a width parameter to st.color_picker by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11516
* [AdvancedLayouts] Adds a width parameter to st.title, st.subheader, and st.header by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11490
* [AdvancedLayouts] Adds a width parameter to st.toggle and st.checkbox by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11496
* Add Button for Copying Exception Messages by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11250
* [AdvancedLayouts] Adds a width parameter to st.radio by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11540
* [AdvancedLayouts] Adds a width parameter to st.spinner by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11547
* Fully support `weight` and `unicode-range` in `[USER]` declaration by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11248
* [feat] Add Japanese yen as a `NumberColumn` & `ProgressColumn` `format` option by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11588
* [AdvancedLayouts] Adds a width parameter to st.caption, st.markdown and st.badge by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11491
* st.navigation(position='top') by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11349
### Bug Fixes 🐛
* Fix data editor when adding and deleting rows by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11183
* Fix content alignment for dataframe columns by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11152
* Ensure script lifecycle occurs for MPAv1 use case by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11258
* Ensure filename extension check is normalized by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11261
* Allow the ability to add case sensitive options to select and multiselect by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11307
* Handle visual glitch for duplicated options by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11306
* Provide more predictable fuzzy matching by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11309
* Scroll long latex formulas horizontally by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10071
* Add safeguard for cached messages cleanup by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11302
* [Fix]: Update `st.column_config` "localized" option by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11297
* [Fix] `st.dataframe`: clear row selections on dropdown sort by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11363
* Exclude tornado 6.5.0 version by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11440
* [Fix] Add rows preserves styling properties by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11414
* Fix crash when editing df index with data editor by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11448
* Tweak markdown styling for task lists & blockquotes by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11237
* Tighten up sidebar width (and therefore padding, scrollbars, popover widgets) by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11412
* [FIX] - Negative Values not displayed in ChartColumn in #10411 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11048
* fix #9339: Altair chart left side cut off on initial load if legend by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10939
* Allow usage of 3000 as app port by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11525
* Fixed issue gh-11327: Plotly chart reset axes not working after reset by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11498
* Fix number column rounding issue by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11520
* Update vega interpreter dependency to fix datetime issue by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11514
* Use private token in `st.map` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11511
* Fix watcher metaclass conflict with torch.classes by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10388
* Add context info to switch page rerun by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11521
* [Fix] Enum formatting not working with styled dataframes by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11049
* Fix with date range selected in st.date_input, hovered dates should change color by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11223
* [fix] Preserve leading whitespaces in markdown codeblock by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10065
* Fixed bug 11330 st.context.timezone becomes empty by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11506
* [fix] Scroll element into view race condition fix by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11552
* Upgrade Source (Sans|Serif|Code) font versions by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11534
* [Fix] `st.number_input` styling by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11576
* [Fix] Render `st.toast` messages above dialogs by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11578
* [fix] st.altair_chart rendering with long titles by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11585
* [fix] Upgrade markdown dependencies by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11553
* [Fix] `st.multiselect` styling by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11577
* Fixed bug 11575: Sorting while filtering by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11587
* [Fix] Reconcile text area & text input placeholder colors by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11630
* [Fix] Reconcile date & time input placeholder colors by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11631
* [Fix] Reconcile chat & number input placeholder colors by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11632
* Add support for font faces from window preamble by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11628
* Fix support for brackets in multi-index column names by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11617
* Support pandas styler coloring for list and link column by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11612
* Fix material icons not rendered with unsafe html by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11633
* Update Source (Sans|Serif|Code) font versions to variable by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11600
* fix #10824 : allow text wrapping when there is no whitespace by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10969
* Make `st.page_link` inherit icon from `st.Page` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10694
* [Fix] Use default width "stretch" for `st.caption` and `st.markdown` to avoid some styling issues by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11644
* Only store media data if in cached function by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11635
* Fix the height of horizontal scrollbars in safari by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11625
### Other Changes
* Update warnings to mention st.user instead of experimental_user by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11198
* Release 1.45.0 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11228
* Add logging if cookie content is too large by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11290
* Release/1.45.1 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11332
* Nicer handling of connection errors by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11366
* Improved new-lines handling for markdown text with background color by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11530
* Update `index.html` preload to variable font by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11646
